description: MiniMax-H3's diffusers repackaging (split to_q/to_k/to_v, what the hub ships) and its native/DiffSynth spelling (one fused qkv_proj per block). The seam is HEAD-INTERLEAVED — 56 head-major (q, k, v) triples, not three stacked blocks — so it is T3: the bytes have to be materialized once, and only one packaging is stored.
name: minimax-h3.split-to-fused-qkv
provenance: THE te#185 INCIDENT IS WHAT THIS FILE IS FOR. DiffSynth's MiniMaxH3DiT accepts the native key set; every minimax-h3 artifact the platform holds is the diffusers one. Under v1 that disagreement was found at load, after the 66 GB download. It is a header fact, and here it is decided from headers: either DERIVABLE through this seam, or REFUSED by name, before a byte moves.

MEASURED KEY COUNTS (this change, from the real banked header of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3:transformer): the diffusers packaging carries 638 tensors and 50 transformer_blocks fuse three ways, so the native topology this morphism computes carries 538. The often-quoted 535 is the upstream native checkpoint's own count; the three-key difference is not measured here and is not claimed.

seams.provenance: RATIFIED, transplanted from `minimax.h3-dit-native@1` and `minimax.h3-dit-diffusers@1` (the v1 documents this morphism replaces). 56 HEAD-MAJOR TRIPLES, and the group count is the load-bearing fact: a flat three-way split is right for head 0 and wrong for the other 55. Measured against the real header: each of to_q/to_k/to_v is [7168, 5376] and 7168 = 56 x 128, so the fused axis is 21504 = 56 groups x (q+k+v) x 128. Each diffusers projection is declared as 56 head slices precisely so its runs ARE the native contract's interleaved seam runs — the two packagings share every attention byte while reading them in different orders.
